# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Type Mismatch (str vs float/datetime) | 9569, 416-15, 402-43, 560-12 | Agent writes values as strings (e.g. date as "MM/DD/YYYY") when the scorer expects native Excel types (float, datetime, int). | BEHAVIORAL | Output Contract / Format |
| 2 | Range & Coverage Mismatches | 227-40, 395-36, 50768 | Agent fails to populate the entire answer range or writes past it. | BEHAVIORAL | Output Contract / Format |
| 3 | Unnecessary Modifications | 395-36, 416-15, 560-12, 39046, 50768 | Agent overwrites cells that were already correct or should have remained untouched. | BEHAVIORAL | Output Contract / Format |
| 4 | Logic Errors (Calculation) | 267-18, 39046, 43436 | Agent implements wrong calculation logic. | BEHAVIORAL | Ordered Procedure / Logic Verification |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type Mismatch | Tighten Output Contract | prompt.md | Enforce native Python types (float, int, datetime) for numeric and date cells; prohibit string conversion. | Yes (passing tasks already use native types) |
| Range & Coverage | Tighten Output Contract | prompt.md | Mandate calculating exact target range bounds and prohibit writing outside the specified range. | Yes (passing tasks already adhere to ranges) |
| Unnecessary Modifications | Add Sourced Rule | prompt.md | Add "Preservation Rule": only modify cells that explicitly require change. | Yes (passing tasks typically only modify necessary cells) |
| Logic Errors | Restructure Procedure | prompt.md | Add a "Logic Sampling" step to the operational procedure: apply logic to a sample and verify before full execution. la | Yes (this is a process improvement) |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- 9569, 416-15: wrote strings instead of float/datetime → contract "Use native Python types (float, int, datetime) for values" prevents this.
- 395-36: wrote past answer range → contract "Prohibit writing to any cell outside the specified answer range" prevents this.
- 416-15, 39046: changed cells that should be untouched → preservation rule "Only modify cells that explicitly require a change" prevents this.
- 39046, 43436: logic mismatch → logic sampling step "Apply logic to a small subset of data and verify before full execution" catches logic errors early.

## Process & features used
- Used subagent for trajectory diagnosis and clustering.
- Applied multiple different improvement types from `guidance/system-prompt/SKILL.md`.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Explicit rules against writing formulas.
- Mandatory verification checklist.
- `openpyxl` for preserving formatting.
- Pandas merge for robust lookups.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- None.
